verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent tracing captures production LLM calls, traces, costs, and tool errors, and claims to help "catch unexpected output issues." However, nothing in the evidence documents evaluators, such as scoring functions or LLM-as-judge, that run on live traffic or on offline datasets. Observability of production AI spans is an adjacent feature, not continuous online evaluation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets
